featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We respect every client's opinion. However, this review does not reflect the complete timeline of events.

The work in question was originally associated with another photographer, and we were approached later to help complete pending deliverables. Despite not being the original service provider, we agreed to assist and accommodated several requests, including priority work before an important personal occasion.

Regarding delays, we had clearly communicated timelines based on when materials, approvals, and requirements were provided. We also never refused to complete the project. The work was prepared and payment discussions took place only after substantial work had already been completed.

We maintain records of our communication and work progress and are confident that they accurately reflect the situation.

We wish the client the very best and will continue focusing on providing quality service to all our customers.
